question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank.

We ______ (agree) to talk to terrorists.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'refuse'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The English meaning of** 'agree' **is 'consent to do or allow something to happen'.(सहमत होना) 

 
 
• **Example:- **'They all agreed to meet at the park'.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym of** 'agree'** in the options given is **'refuse'.** 
 
• The English meaning of **'refuse'** is 'express unwillingness to do or accept something'.(इनकार करना) 
 
 
• **Example:-** 'She refused to sign the document'.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- ** 'refuse'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **'Grant'** English meaning is 'agree to give or allow (something requested) to', (अनुदान)
 
• Option 2 **'Admit' **English meaning is 'confess to be true or to be the case',(स्वीकार करना)
 
• Option 3** 'Allow' **English meaning is 'give (someone) permission to do something', (अनुमति देना)
